gloss: to add (in writing); to write in addition

definitions.gloss: to add (in writing); to write in addition; to append
definitions.explanation: To insert or attach additional written content to an existing document, note, or text, such as appending a remark to a memo or adding a clause to a contract.

examples.japanese: ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧{書|か}き{加|くわ}えた。
examples.english: I added a word to the memo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{加|くわ}えた。
examples.english: I added new data to the report.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧{書|か}き{加|くわ}えて⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Could you add one condition to the contract?

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write) and ⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧ (to add). Used when appending or inserting additional written content to an existing document or text.

USAGE:
The target document is marked by ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, and the content being added is marked by ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{加|くわ}える

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{加|くわ}える: to add to a memo
- ⟦{注釈|ちゅうしゃく}→注釈：09766_chuushaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{加|くわ}える: to add an annotation
- ⟦{補足|ほそく}→補足：08386_hosoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{加|くわ}える: to add a supplement
- ⟦{余白|よはく}→余白：06838_yohaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{加|くわ}える: to write in the margin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える→付け加える：11520_tsukekuwaeru⟧: to add on — more general, not limited to writing
- ⟦{追記|ついき}→追記：17128_tsuiki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to add a postscript — more formal, often at the end of a document
- ⟦{書|か}き{足|た}す→書き足す：06851_kakitasu⟧: to write more, to supplement — very similar, slightly more casual
